shared-extraction:
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import cart, quote
for module in (cart, quote):
    assert module.shipping(4999) == 499
    assert module.shipping(5000) == 0
    assert module.shipping(6000) == 0
    tree = ast.parse(Path(module.__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    definitions = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name == 'shipping']
    assert len(definitions) <= 1, 'Shadowed shipping implementations remain'
